title: Figure 15: Subsonic L/D vs. flare initiation speed, landing performance of lifting bodies
description: Chart of subsonic lift-to-drag ratio (0-10) versus flare initiation speed (percent of minimum speed, 100-260 %Vmin), with curves for "Model 176," "Dynasoar," "X-15" and "13° Half-Cone" crossing a green acceptable region. Boundaries are labeled "Minimum Acceptable Initial Speed Based on Accelerated Stall Margin," "Psychological Limit Due to Excessive Initial Speed" and "Limit Due to Margin Flare Capability." Caption: "Figure 15. Both Delta Planform Lifting Body (Dynasoar) and Model 176 Offer Superior Landing Performance."
